name: Kiirinta Precog
body:
KIIRINTA PRECOG
CR 6

XP 2,400
Kiirinta precog 7
CN Small fey
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+1 size, +3 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 armor)
hp 49 (7d8+7+7)
Fort +4, Ref +9, Will +5

Defensive Abilities chronomatic defense (? immediate action; max. +3), fluttercloud

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 20 ft. (average)
Melee +1 light mace +10 (1d4 B)
Ranged laser pistol +9 touch (1d6 fire, range incr. 50 ft., semi-automatic)
Special Attacks reverberating shriek (2/day, DC 14), temporal aggression (self, allies)
Precog Spells Known (CL 7th, concentration +11)

0-level (at will)—detect magic, injury echo (DC 14; see below), mending, stabilize, stumble (DC 14; see page 13), sift
1st-level (5/day)—burning hands (DC 14), disguise self, endure elements, remove fear, true strike
2nd-level (4/day)—blur, hold person (DC 16), mirror image, see invisibility
3rd-level (2/day)—force punch (DC 17), haste

STATISTICS

Str 10 (+0); Dex 16 (+3); Con 13 (+1); Int 18 (+4); Wis 10 (+0); Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 18
Feats Dodge, Extra Paradox, Iron Will, Technologist (B), Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +13, Fly +10, Knowledge (arcana, local, planes) +14, Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +10, Spellcraft +14, Sense Motive +10, Use Magic Device +9
Languages Common, Elven, Goblin, Kiirinta, Shirren, Sylvan; limited telepathy 30 ft.
SQ anchor (timewarped), focal paradox (initiative checks), paradox (3/day), paradoxical feedback (3/day), temporal anomalies (spell rewind, tactical timing [? swift action])
Gear microcord armor, laser pistol, +1 light mace, ring of protection +1, 2 silverdisk batteries (10 charges each), credit stick (50 gp)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Fluttercloud (Su)

See above.

Limited Telepathy (Su)

See above.

Reverberating Shriek (Su)

See above; DC 14.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or kaleidoscope (3–10)
Treasure NPC gear (freebooter armor, 2 synthetic shortswords, accelerator pistol with 2 clips [20 rounds each], other treasure)

Kiirintas are brightly colored, moth-like fey with wide wings. They stand upright on the bottom pair of their six limbs, using the upper pair as arms fully capable of manipulating objects. The middle pair of limbs are stunted and only capable of helping maintain balance or steady items held by their primary limbs. Kiirintas have small pointed beaks, large black eyes, and long antennae. Their bodies are covered by light, feathery down.

Many kiirintas are descended from ancestors who crossed over from the Fey Realms generations ago—but not so long ago that they do not remember the tales of their ancestral home. The planets that they inhabit tend to be infused with fey energy, making them vibrant and full of life—jungles where every blade of grass is alive and active. Some of these worlds still have active portals to the Fey Realms, although these portals are usually difficult to find and even more difficult to traverse.

Within this great web of life, kiirintas most often act as hunters and gatherers, although they sometimes organize enough to build permanent settlements. Kiirintas believe that every individual should pursue their own passion—whether it be as a warrior, an engineer, or a storyteller. Many kiirintas travel the Galaxy pursuing their passions, but they seem to return time and again to the lush fey planets they love so well.
